clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group comparisons (t-tests) of percentile distributions; supervised classification (regularized discriminant analysis, klaR in R) using percentile features with 10-fold CV; mean AUC=0.95 (all 10 features), 0.916 (volumes), 0.894 (sagittal features).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Sex-specific corpus callosum growth curves generalized to a different scanner and enabled accurate ASD identification (AUC≈0.95) using deviation-based features.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Growth curves (10th/50th/90th centiles with 95% CI) captured nonlinear, sex-differentiated development (1–6 years), with higher growth in mid-anterior and central subregions. In independent Dataset 2 (3T), ASD showed left-skewed percentile distributions and larger morphometrics versus TDC (except anterior volume) and markedly higher Mahalanobis distances (median 42.65 vs 9.42). RDA classifiers trained on percentile features achieved mean AUC=0.95 (all features), with volumes-only AUC=0.916 and sagittal-only AUC=0.894.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Sex-specific GAMLSS (BCT) with polynomial age effect and bootstrap CIs; deviations summarized via percentiles and Mahalanobis distance; classification via RDA on deviation features.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Training on a single-site 1.5T cohort without explicit site harmonization; external validation limited to one independent site/scanner; ages for clinical dataset not fully characterized; peak-age projections are exploratory; broader population diversity and multi-site calibrations are needed.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Sedation procedures were used for children under 4 years and when necessary for older children to reduce motion. Training data acquired on Siemens 1.5T MPRAGE; validation on Philips 3T 3D-TFE. Technical GAMLSS details (distribution selection, bootstrap) provided in Supplementary Methods.
